title: Closed coefficient mate and scalar-map normalization helpers
statement: For finite coefficient rings, the closed coefficient mate is defined by the ordinary proper direct-image adjunction and the scalarMate inverse; the scalar dualizing map agrees with the corresponding global mate.

proof.text: Unfold the published scalar map and global mate definitions and use adjunction Hom-equivalence naturality.
Define the closed mate as the adjunction transpose of the inverse scalarMate followed by scalar extension of the proper counit.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact project theorem; used Hom-equivalence naturality.
Found source definitions and proved equality in module.

lean.statement:
def closedDualizingCoefficientMate
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {V P : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian V] [IsNoetherian P]
    (i : V ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (M : DerivedCategoryModule A P) :
    (scalarExtension φ V).obj
        ((rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj M) ⟶
      (rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) i).obj
        ((scalarExtension φ P).obj M)
